name: Director Siobhán Kerrigan

intro.text: Regional Director, Ireland. You'll have seen our launch. 'Ireland's Ancient East Experience'. Lanyards included.
Kilkenny Castle would make a lovely Members' Lounge. Shall we discuss it? Battle first, obviously.

win: Annoying. You're very annoying. I'll be noting that in the minutes.
after: Newgrange is booked for the solstice. Private event. You're not on the list.
